npcs.name: Sailor working on ss anne night
npcs.text: I've been working all day I'm absolutely shattered.
npcs.repeat_text: Most passengers went back to the ship earlier but I saw some shady characters actually getting off

npcs.name: Sailor 2 pier 1 night 3
npcs.text: Oh boy I am pooped. Some guys dressed in black headed past this way earlier as if they were going to go to the forest
npcs.repeat_text: The forest is still closed until morning though so not sure where they were going

npcs.name: Sailor working on dock night 3
npcs.text: I can't wait for the SS Anne to leave now, I've never been busier
npcs.repeat_text: Us sailors are hard workers as it is but this is too much for us!

npcs.name: Sabrina NPC
npcs.text: Your town is much quieter than Saffron. I'm Sabrina, I knew you would be coming. You'll be challenging me soon I can see that, but this might help you win against me.
npcs.repeat_text: Good luck with the Gym Hero Challenge. I know you're going to do well.

npcs.name: Giovanni NPC
npcs.text: You shouldn't be out here so late, there's not always nice people wandering around at this hour. I promised not to cause trouble while I'm here but why not a little mischief? As proof I'm not evil, take this
npcs.repeat_text: I am Giovanni. I was once the leader of Team Rocket and the gym leader in Viridian. Now I'm not formerly either, but Team Rocket will always live on.

opponents.name: Birdspotter_Gregg
opponents.meet_text: My friend got hungry so decided to head back, but I'm interested to see what birds are out at night.
opponents.rematch_text: This really is a great spot for birds and cards!
opponents.first_win_text: Do you hate birds or something?.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Well at least I can watch the birds from around here.
opponents.loss_text: Looking after birds really isn't easy!

opponents.name: Guitarist_Jonesy
opponents.meet_text: We're in a band and we're currently touring. We're just passing through to our next gig so having a quick jam here
opponents.first_win_text: Damn I snapped a string while we were jamming
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should come to one of our gigs!

opponents.name: Guitarist_Howard
opponents.meet_text: We're the Toxtricity Rockers, we're a duo that's pretty big in Johto.
opponents.rematch_text: You here to hear a song or a rematch?
opponents.loss_text: If it's any consolation I'll give you a discount on our album

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.rematch_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Garden_Manager_Louis
opponents.meet_text: I might be the garden manager but I do know how to have fun
opponents.rematch_text: Look at how great the gardens look
opponents.first_win_text: Even with all this sun I couldn't win
opponents.rematch_win_text: Ever fancied being a gardener yourself?

opponents.name: Sailor_Bob
opponents.meet_text: Most of the passengers have returned on board for the night now so it's quiet again as usual.
opponents.rematch_text: There's still time before the morning shift
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to during the day now the ship has docked
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice

opponents.name: Card_Elder_Rayne
opponents.meet_text: Hoh Hoh, are you ready to feel the torrent? If you win I'll give you a medal to prove your triumph.
opponents.rematch_text: Hoh Hoh! I enjoyed the battle that much I'd also like another!
opponents.first_win_text: Congratulations on your win. You've earned this medal and my respect.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card_Elder_Hamish
opponents.meet_text: Back for the challenge then hey? Remember you'll need to defeat all 3 of us if you want to progress.
opponents.rematch_text: Very well, I always enjoy a good challenge!
opponents.first_win_text: Well done, that was quite the battle. Take my medal and continue forth.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Battling like this makes me feel young again.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card_Elder_Waverly
opponents.meet_text: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge
opponents.rematch_text: Up for another round then? Happy to oblige
opponents.first_win_text: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way
opponents.loss_text: When you fail, get up and try again.

opponents.name: Hiker_Ben
opponents.meet_text: Well that's incredibly dissapointing. I was hoping to have a trek through the forest but they've told me it's shut so I have nowhere to go now.
opponents.first_win_text: Well that's another dissapointment to my day
opponents.rematch_text: The forest has to be open soon surely
opponents.loss_text: At least that's given me a nice little boost after the bad news

opponents.name: Psychic_Brienne
opponents.meet_text: I love the peace of the harbour at night, the sound of the waves in the dark are really relaxing
opponents.rematch_text: It's easier to meditate at night
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too

opponents.name: ENGINEER_BRAD
opponents.meet_text: Hey, I've got some shocking cards I want to try out
opponents.rematch_text: It's rare I have to work at night so I'm free for another match
opponents.first_win_text: I simply cannot fix that at all
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to weld my cards at this rate
opponents.loss_text: Hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

opponents.name: Bad_Dude_Paul
opponents.meet_text: Heh you want to try and beat me kid??
opponents.first_win_text: Heh you're pretty tough, you wanna join our gang?
opponents.rematch_text: Damn... they're gonna kick me out of the cool guy biker gang for this
opponents.rematch_win_text: Now they're DEFINITELY going to kick me out of the cool guy biker gang...

opponents.name: Bad_Dude_Wayne
opponents.meet_text: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way
opponents.first_win_text: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I need some more of these Dark cards

opponents.name: ROCKET_GRUNT_DAMIEN
opponents.meet_text: I'm here on bosses orders but we're not starting until tomorrow so you'll be good practice
opponents.first_win_text: Oh no, don't tell the boss
opponents.rematch_text: I'm not really a bad guy but I can't let people know that
opponents.loss_text: Ha ha, you didn't put up much of a fight.

opponents.name: ROCKET_GRUNT_PENNY
opponents.meet_text: Team Rocket used to be the most feared group in the world. Maybe we will be again
opponents.first_win_text: Weren't you even a little bit scared?
opponents.rematch_text: Have you ever heard of us before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I really gotta act more scary
opponents.loss_text: If you didn't already you should definitely fear us now
